title: Review shape and planning before implementation
description: Add a persisted shape decision and bounded semantic planning review ahead of implementation. The deterministic health score remains structural evidence, while an independent review decides whether the shape and plan cohere. Non-goals: AI-scored product taste, self-approval by authoring skills, or another unbounded review loop.

behaviors.title: Persist an explicit shape decision
behaviors.trigger: A shaped issue is submitted for planning
behaviors.expected: Loopbreaker stores the problem, appetite, smallest slice, non-goals, success signal, reversibility, owner, risks, and exactly one disposition; only proceed releases the shape gate
behaviors.verify: Exercise proceed, spike, park, reject, incomplete, idempotent, and frozen shape records through the domain API

behaviors.title: Bound semantic planning review to two plus one
behaviors.trigger: A planning-ready issue is submitted for independent review
behaviors.expected: The reviewer records stable shape/planning findings and at most comprehensive, repair-verification, and decision-only passes with no automatic pass four
behaviors.verify: Run pass ordering, finding stability, approval, re-scope, return-to-shaping, and pass-four rejection fixtures

behaviors.title: Enforce the complete authority chain
behaviors.trigger: Implementation, code review, or shipping is considered
behaviors.expected: Authority is evaluated in order as shape proceed, planning health ready, planning review approved, then behavior verification or waiver; later gates cannot average away earlier failures
behaviors.verify: Drive one issue through every gate and prove pass one plus shipping remain held at the exact active authority until it clears

behaviors.title: Expose an independent review-planning agent workflow
behaviors.trigger: A builder invokes the CLI or an agent invokes the new skill and MCP tools
behaviors.expected: The review-planning skill loads persisted readiness, reviews without editing the authored contract, records stable findings and bounded passes, and reports exact authority state
behaviors.verify: Discover and call the built CLI/MCP tools, validate the skill package, and forward-test the skill in a clean agent context

behaviors.title: Visualize and migrate the expanded readiness graph
behaviors.trigger: A builder opens an existing or newly shaped issue
behaviors.expected: The graph shows shape, planning health, planning review, implementation contract, review passes, and shipping in order; legacy issues can backfill missing pre-implementation authority without rewriting prior evidence
behaviors.verify: Inspect blocked and approved graphs in a real browser, run legacy migrations and backfills, then complete the full repository and package verification suite

planning.outcome: An independent bounded review establishes that product shape and implementation planning cohere before code begins.
planning.appetite: One focused schema, domain, CLI, MCP, skill, graph, migration, and live-proof slice.

work_units.title: Persist and derive shape plus planning-review authority
work_units.done_when: Every ordered gate is persisted, bounded, migrated, and enforced.

work_units.title: Expose CLI and MCP review surfaces
work_units.done_when: Agents can inspect readiness and record shape, findings, and passes through compact TOON tools.

work_units.title: Ship the reviewer skill and authority graph
work_units.done_when: A clean agent and real browser can follow the same persisted authority chain.

proofs.method: Exercise shape records and freeze behavior in domain tests plus built CLI.
Exercise every planning-review pass and finding transition against SQLite.
Drive a real database through each ordered authority and inspect exact gate state.
Call the bundled MCP server and forward-test the installed review-planning skill.
Inspect blocked and approved graphs with agent-browser and run full migration/package verification.

planning.production_wiring: The SQLite domain substrate feeds readiness derivation, pass admission, shipping, CLI, MCP, HTTP/WebSocket refresh, the React Flow graph, and all five shipped skills.
planning.rollback: Disable shape and planning-review enforcement while retaining their tables and records; planning health and behavior verification remain intact.
planning.migration: Create shape_assessments, planning_review_passes, and planning_findings idempotently; allow one backfill path for legacy issues before freezing authority.
planning.decision_owner: Issue owner or named human approver

risks.risk: The new reviewer becomes another endless loop.
risks.mitigation: Use two-plus-one passes, stable findings, terminal pass-three dispositions, and no pass four.

risks.risk: A planning score is mistaken for semantic approval.
risks.mitigation: Keep planning health and planning-review approval as separate conjunctive authorities.

risks.risk: Legacy shipped issues become permanently blocked.
risks.mitigation: Permit explicit one-time backfills without rewriting existing review or evidence.
